errors_encountered.error: CS8629 'Nullable value type may be null' x9 in Scenario4_NumberParsing.xaml.cs (lines 68-108)
errors_encountered.root_cause: INumberParser.ParseDouble()/ParseInt()/ParseUInt() return double?/long?/ulong? (WinRT IReference). Nullable-oblivious UWP code calls .Value directly; under the WinUI 3 scaffold's <Nullable>enable</Nullable> this warns.
errors_encountered.fix: Replace unchecked .Value with the null-coalescing operator: 'percentFormat.ParseDouble(percent1) ?? 0' (session-log.txt:3559-3565, three edits covering percent/decimal/currency).

errors_encountered.root_cause: The Windows-universal-samples static accessor 'MainPage.Current' is nullable (MainPage? Current), but the UWP code assigns it into a non-nullable local 'MainPage rootPage = MainPage.Current;'. Warns under <Nullable>enable</Nullable>.
errors_encountered.fix: Declare the local nullable: 'MainPage? rootPage = MainPage.Current;' (session-log.txt:3494).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: First build succeeded with 20 nullable warnings (CS8601 + 9x CS8629 shown twice); agent then spent a dedicated fix-up pass rewriting .Value -> ?? 0 across three parse groups and declaring MainPage.Current nullable.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: WinUI 3 scaffold csproj ships <Nullable>enable</Nullable>; UWP source is nullable-oblivious. The two dominant recurring patterns are the SampleConfiguration 'MainPage.Current' static and WinRT nullable-returning Parse*/IReference<T> methods accessed via .Value.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Applied '?? <default>' to nullable-returning WinRT calls and nullable local declaration for MainPage.Current; rebuild clean (0 warnings).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A prominent 'nullable warnings after the namespace rewrite' entry in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' section naming both dominant patterns, so the agent writes null-safe code on first pass instead of a separate cleanup pass.
